# Polyfills across the engines

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_polyfill_docs.py from provisa/transpiler/polyfill: do not edit by hand. -->

Each PostgreSQL feature of the polyfill grid on each engine: **native** (the engine answers as PostgreSQL does, with no polyfill), **polyfilled** (Provisa supplies PostgreSQL's behaviour, with no difference), **differs** (polyfilled, with a limitation), **refused** (a client receives the refusal its row states). The polyfills and limitations of each engine are on its page: [DuckDB](duckdb.md), [Trino](trino.md), [ClickHouse](clickhouse.md).

| Feature | Family | DuckDB | Trino | ClickHouse |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `array_ndims` | arrays | polyfilled | polyfilled | polyfilled |
| `array_dims` | arrays | polyfilled | polyfilled | polyfilled |
| `array_lower` | arrays | polyfilled | polyfilled | polyfilled |
| `array_upper` | arrays | polyfilled | polyfilled | polyfilled |
| `array_fill` | arrays | differs | differs | differs |
| `array_positions` | arrays | polyfilled | polyfilled | polyfilled |
| `array_replace` | arrays | polyfilled | polyfilled | polyfilled |
| `array_sample` | arrays | polyfilled | polyfilled | differs |
| `array_shuffle` | arrays | polyfilled | polyfilled | polyfilled |
| `trim_array` | arrays | polyfilled | polyfilled | differs |
| `generate_subscripts` | arrays | polyfilled | refused | refused |
